when.quote: To open a personal checking account, ensure all of the following are true:

info.about: Any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address. These are checked against the records on file.
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me your full name and two of the following: date of birth, email, phone number or address?

info.about: Whether the customer uses ATMs abroad and wants the fees waived or rebated
info.ask: Do you take cash out of ATMs abroad or outside our network, and do you want those fees covered?

info.about: Whether the customer needs no foreign transaction fees on purchases abroad
info.ask: Do you buy things in foreign currencies?

info.about: The balance the customer can keep in the checking account, including the most they can keep
info.ask: Roughly how much will you keep in this account, and what is the most you could keep?

info.about: Whether the customer wants to hold foreign currencies
info.ask: Do you get paid in, or want to hold, any foreign currencies?

info.about: The customer's age. Student, teen and senior accounts depend on it.
info.ask: Can you confirm your date of birth?

info.about: Other stated wishes (for example eco or premium features). These are nice to have; they never outweigh a hard requirement.
info.ask: Is there anything else that matters to you in this account?

info.about: The customer's existing bank accounts: type, class, status, balance and date opened

steps.do: Greet the customer and ask for name plus two identity values
steps.quote: To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address.

steps.do: Look up the customer's record using the name, email or user id they gave
steps.quote: 1. Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log
steps.if: 2 of the values match the record
steps.quote: 1. Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Log the verification
steps.if: 2 of the values match the record
steps.quote: 1. Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Get the customer's existing accounts to check eligibility
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Check checking eligibility: age 18 or over, no more than 4 personal checking accounts, no checking account closed for cause in the past 6 months
steps.quote: 2. Check eligibility requirements listed above.

steps.do: Ask for every checking requirement (foreign ATM, foreign transaction fees, balance range, multi-currency, age, other preferences) before choosing
steps.quote: 3. Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: Rule out every personal checking account that fails a hard requirement (see rules). Recommend the ONE account that meets them all; for a frequent traveller with a modest balance who needs multi-currency, that is Purple Account. Explain briefly, without internal details.
steps.quote: Multi-currency wallet: Yes with up to 30 supported foreign currencies

steps.do: Get the customer's agreement to open the recommended account under its full official name
steps.quote: Personal checking account_class options must use the full official name ending with 'Account' (e.g., 'Blue Account', 'Green Account (checking)').

steps.do: Unlock the account-opening tool
steps.quote: 4. Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

steps.do: Open the checking account

arguments.account_class: the confirmed full official name, e.g. 'Purple Account'

steps.quote: 4. Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

steps.do: Confirm to the customer that the account is open and give its details
steps.quote: 4. Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

rules.rule: The customer must be verified and at least 18.
rules.quote: 2. The customer is at least 18 years old.

rules.rule: The customer may hold no more than 4 personal checking accounts.
rules.quote: 3. The customer does not exceed 4 personal checking accounts.

rules.rule: Do not open if any checking account was closed for cause in the past 6 months.
rules.quote: 4. The customer has no checking accounts closed for cause in the past 6 months.

rules.rule: Purple Account is the only personal checking account with a multi-currency wallet. It also has 0% foreign transaction fees.
rules.quote: No foreign transaction fees: 0%

rules.rule: Purple Account charges $0 for foreign ATM withdrawals and rebates ATM operator fees up to $30 a month.
rules.quote: Global ATM fee rebates: up to $30 monthly worldwide

rules.rule: Purple's monthly fee is waived at a $3,750 minimum daily balance. This is within a 3–5k balance range.
rules.quote: Minimum daily balance to waive the monthly maintenance fee: $3,750

rules.rule: Bluest Account (premium) is out for anyone who cannot deposit $75,000.
rules.quote: Deposit at least $75,000 to open your account.

rules.rule: Evergreen (eco) charges foreign ATM fees and has no multi-currency wallet, so it fails a travel need.
rules.quote: Foreign ATM withdrawal fee: 2% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $3.00 per transaction.

rules.rule: Dark Green (student, age 17–26) and Gold Years (62+) depend on age. Light Green is a teen account.
rules.quote: You must be at least 62 years old to qualify.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, and the single agreed checking account is open, with its details given to the customer.

when.quote: Procedure for opening personal savings accounts.

info.about: How many withdrawals per month the customer needs without fees
info.ask: How often will you take money out of savings?

info.about: The balance the customer can keep, including the most they can keep
info.ask: How much do you expect to keep in savings, and what is the most?
Do you have any requirement on how interest compounds?

info.about: Whether out-of-network ATM fees should be rebated
info.ask: Do you use out-of-network ATMs with this account?

info.about: The lowest APY the customer will accept
info.ask: Is there an interest rate you're aiming for?

info.about: Whether the customer wants a multi-product relationship bonus
info.ask: Do you want a bonus for holding several Rho-Bank products?

info.about: Whether to transfer the opening deposit from checking now
info.ask: Would you like me to transfer the opening deposit from your checking account now?

steps.do: Re-read the customer's accounts for savings eligibility
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Check savings eligibility: an active checking account held at least 14 days, fewer than 5 savings accounts, no collections or negative balances
steps.quote: The customer’s checking account tenure is at least 14 days.

steps.do: Ask for all savings requirements before choosing
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Rule out every savings account that fails a hard requirement (see rules). Recommend the ONE account that meets them all; for a 5–7k balance with frequent withdrawals, ATM rebates, a relationship bonus, daily compounding and at least 3% APY, that is Silver Plus Account.
steps.quote: Tier 1 APY: 3.0% for balances below the Tier 2 threshold.

steps.do: Confirm the exact account_class with the customer
steps.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Open the savings account

arguments.account_class: the confirmed full official name, e.g. 'Silver Plus Account'

steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Ask whether to transfer the opening deposit from checking now
steps.quote: Ask the customer if they want you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now.

steps.do: Transfer the opening deposit from checking to the new savings account

arguments.amount: the opening deposit amount confirmed with the customer

steps.quote: If yes: use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount from the customer’s checking account to the newly opened savings account.

steps.do: If declined, state the 30-day funding window and offer a check deposit (next job)
steps.quote: If no: inform the customer they have 30 days to fund the account (via internal transfer or external deposit) or the account will be closed.

steps.do: Give the new account details, including its account id, and the funding status
steps.quote: Provide the new account details and confirm the funding status or the funding deadline.

rules.rule: The customer must have an active checking account held at least 14 days.
rules.quote: The customer’s checking account tenure is at least 14 days.

rules.rule: The customer must hold fewer than 5 personal savings accounts.
rules.quote: Customer currently holds fewer than 5 personal savings accounts.

rules.rule: The customer must have no collections and no negative balances.
rules.quote: Customer has no accounts in collections and no negative balances.

rules.rule: Silver Plus: $1,000 to open, $2,500 ongoing minimum, 15 free withdrawals a month, daily compounding.
rules.quote: You have up to 15 free withdrawals each month.

rules.rule: Silver Plus rebates ATM fees up to 25 a month.
rules.quote: Receive ATM fee rebates up to 25 each month.

rules.rule: Silver Plus has a relationship bonus.
rules.quote: Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.

rules.rule: Silver: only 10 free withdrawals, and 2.5% APY below $10,000, so it fails frequent withdrawals and a 3% APY floor.
rules.quote: Track your withdrawal activity; transactions beyond 10 in a cycle may incur an excess withdrawal fee as described in your account disclosures.

rules.rule: Gold requires a $10,000 balance (minimum reduced to $5,000 only for Gold Rewards Card holders).
rules.quote: Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.

rules.rule: Green Account (savings): 8 free withdrawals a month, and no ATM rebates without an EcoCard.
rules.quote: Plan withdrawals to stay within 8 each month.

rules.rule: Bronze: only 6 free withdrawals and 2.0% APY.
rules.quote: Free withdrawals per month: 6

rules.rule: Gold Plus ($25,000), Platinum ($50,000), Platinum Plus ($100,000) and Diamond Elite ($100,000 to open) all need far larger balances.
rules.quote: Maintain at least $50,000 to preserve Platinum benefits.

rules.rule: Linked checking APY boosts apply only to listed pairings (e.g. Purple + Platinum Plus or Gold; Blue + Silver Plus), and boosts do not stack.
rules.quote: Only the HIGHEST checking account APY boost is applied to the savings account.

jobs.done_when: The single agreed savings account is open, the customer has its account id, and it has either been funded or the customer has been told about the 30-day funding window.

when.quote: Customers can deposit checks into their checking or savings accounts using mobile check deposit.

info.about: The id of the account to deposit into (for example, the new savings account)
info.ask: Which account would you like to deposit the check into?
What is the amount on the check?

steps.do: Give the customer the check deposit tool
steps.quote: To help a customer deposit a check, give them the deposit_check_3847 tool.

steps.do: Tell the customer to call deposit_check_3847 with the destination account id and the check amount
steps.quote: Have the user call deposit_check_3847(account_id, check_amount) where account_id is the ID of the account they want to deposit into and check_amount is the amount of the check in USD.

steps.do: Customer deposits the check
steps.quote: Note: The agent cannot deposit checks on behalf of the customer - this action must be performed by the customer themselves through the mobile app.

steps.do: Re-read the accounts to confirm the deposit and balance
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Confirm the balance and the usual 1–2 business days for funds to become available
steps.quote: Standard deposits are typically available within 1-2 business days.

rules.rule: The agent never deposits a check itself; the customer runs deposit_check_3847.
rules.quote: Note: The agent cannot deposit checks on behalf of the customer - this action must be performed by the customer themselves through the mobile app.

rules.rule: The Silver Plus mobile deposit limit is $5,000 a day.
rules.quote: You can deposit checks through the mobile app up to a daily total of $5,000.

jobs.done_when: The customer has run deposit_check_3847 into the chosen account, and the agent has confirmed the resulting balance from the account records.
